entries.text: 我是派舒蕾・慕滋的店長，\n阿楓～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_first_00

entries.text: 哎呀～？這麼說來我好像是\n以道館館主的身分被叫來的～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_first_01

entries.text: 沒想到能在這種地方遇到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\n真是不可思議呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_01

entries.text: 是我叫妳來的
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 真不可思議
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_select_02

entries.text:
哎呀～？說是這麼說，
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的臉色看起來很平靜呢～？\c
難道是[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳
把我叫來的～！？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_02b

entries.text: 如果是這樣的話～\n就一點都不會不可思議了呢～\r\n呵呵呵……[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_03

entries.text: 既然我是被叫來當講師的，\n那可得認真一點才行～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_04

entries.text: 就讓我把蟲寶可夢的魅力！\n傳遞給學園的大家吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp01_05

entries.text: 前一陣子我在生態巨蛋\n啦啦啦地悠閒散步的時候～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_01

entries.text: 和可愛的蟲寶可夢\n有了一場美妙的邂逅～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_02

entries.text: 牠又小又可愛，\n而且擁有著電屬性～\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳知道那種寶可夢的名字嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_03

entries.text: 電擊怪
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 燈籠魚
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 電電蟲
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_select_03

entries.text:
哎呀呀～？那個大概
不是蟲寶可夢～！\c
牠那時「電電」地叫了～
也許牠是電電蟲～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04

entries.text: 應該就是那孩子～！\n因為牠還「電電」地叫了～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_04b

entries.text: 那是帕底亞沒有的\n蟲寶可夢呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_05

entries.text: 新的甜點就用電電蟲\n當靈感來做做看吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp02_06

entries.text: 最近從生態巨蛋加入到\n我的同行隊伍的寶可夢，\r\n是誰呢～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_01

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_02

entries.text: 電蜘蛛
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 滴蛛霸
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 阿利多斯
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_select_04

entries.text: 哎呀～答案不太對喔～\n請再多想想看吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03

entries.text: 答對了！完全正確～！\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有在好好觀察我呢～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_03b

entries.text: 滴蛛霸擁有著水屬性，\n平時棲息在水邊喔～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_04

entries.text: 在[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳散步的時候\n順便去找找牠如何～！？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_sp03_05

entries.text: 多虧了[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，我才能遇見新的蟲寶可夢，\n真是讓我笑呵呵呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_00

entries.text: 要不我們來交換寶可夢～\n然後培育更～多的蟲寶可夢吧～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_02

entries.text: 是[VAR 0x0101(0001)]呀～\n好可愛喔～謝謝～！\r\n我會好好照顧，讓牠羽化的～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_01_04

entries.text: 初訓家不是自己的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_01

entries.text: 稀有的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_02

entries.text: 異色的寶可夢\n無法用來交換。
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_02_03

entries.text:
哎呀～？同行寶可夢如果只有１隻的話，
是不能進行交換的喔～\c
請讓同行寶可夢增加到２隻以上，
然後再來找我吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_00

entries.text: 想見蟲寶可夢的時候，\n隨時歡迎[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳再來～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_03_01

entries.text: 哎呀～？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳想要交換\n蟲寶可夢了嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_trade_04_00

entries.text: 哎呀哎呀～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳該不會是\n想邀請我來對戰吧～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_talkto_00

entries.text: 原來不是呀～\n是我太武斷了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_cancel_00

entries.text: 好期待能嚐一嚐[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的寶可夢\n羽化成什麼滋味了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 哎呀～真不愧是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳呢～\n我完全不是對手～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 真的是羽化得很優秀呢～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 對戰之後，\n來嚐嚐這個甜點如何～？[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 祝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳今後前進的道路\n一路仍然甜蜜又順口唷～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 63]
entries.label: coach_paldea_rival_reward_00

entries.text: 為了讚賞[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那戰勝蟲寶可夢們\n的實力，這是給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 呵呵～\n下次再來對戰吧～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: 呵呵呵！我使出全力獲勝了～！\n感覺真的很～棒呢～！\r\n謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳和我對戰～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
在生態巨蛋散步
真的很有趣～\c
有很多我沒見過的寶可夢，
讓我得到了好～多甜點的靈感～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
多虧有派舒蕾・慕滋的
員工們的努力，
我才有機會外出～\c
一定要好好珍惜那些
支持自己的人啊～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
蟲太晶化之後的
那對觸角很可愛吧～？\c
要是所～有的寶可夢
都太晶化成蟲屬性就好了～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]食慾旺盛，
總是餓著肚子～！\c
我做的甜點牠也
吃了很～多喔～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_03

entries.text: 我送給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的\n三蜜蜂是雌性的～\r\n能進化成蜂女王喔～[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_04

entries.text:
我想起了首席
跟我說的一件事～\c
她說[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳
把我選為了
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳最喜歡的道館館主～\c
謝謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳那像甜點一樣
甜蜜又溫柔的話～\c
下次我會專為[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳
烤些杯子蛋糕過來的～！[VAR 0x0114(0016)]
entries.label: coach_gym_mushi_randomtalk_sp
